research_mode: official Ministry of Justice and HMPPS accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Homicides in custody
verified_claims: There were 9 homicides in the 12 months to March 2026, up from 6 and a new peak in the published time series.
limitations: Very small counts are volatile and cannot support inference about any neighbourhood or parcel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Deaths awaiting classification
verified_claims: Seventy-four deaths were recorded as other, including 43 awaiting further information before final classification.
limitations: Outstanding toxicology, post-mortem or inquest evidence means categories can be revised upward later.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly death volatility warning
verified_claims: The publication explicitly says quarterly deaths should be treated cautiously because of greater volatility and potential seasonal effects.
limitations: This warning prevents short-period changes being promoted as stable local risk signals.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Self-harm incident total
verified_claims: There were 72,753 self-harm incidents in the 12 months to December 2025, 8% fewer than the 79,060 incidents in the previous 12 months.
limitations: Incident counts may include repeated events by the same individual and are not community safety observations.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Self-harm rate
verified_claims: The self-harm rate was 837 incidents per 1,000 prisoners in the 12 months to December 2025, an 8% annual decrease.
limitations: The prison denominator and institutional exposure are not transferable to parcels or the general population.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Latest-quarter self-harm incidents
verified_claims: The three months to December 2025 recorded 17,322 self-harm incidents, 7% fewer than the preceding quarter's 18,601.
limitations: Quarterly change is an estate-level operational statistic and cannot identify parcel risk.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Latest-quarter self-harm rate
verified_claims: The quarterly self-harm rate fell 5% to 200 incidents per 1,000 prisoners in the three months to December 2025.
limitations: A quarterly institutional rate is not an address-level safety measure.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Individuals who self-harmed
verified_claims: There were 13,394 individuals who self-harmed in the 12 months to December 2025, 3.5% fewer than 13,884 in the previous period.
limitations: This counts people in custody and must not be combined with community-population measures without a valid crosswalk.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Individuals self-harming rate
verified_claims: The rate of individuals self-harming decreased 3.6% to 154 per 1,000 prisoners.
limitations: The denominator is prisoners, not residents, properties or land parcels.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Incidents per self-harming individual
verified_claims: Self-harm incidents per individual decreased 4.6%, from 5.7 to 5.4 in the latest 12 months.
limitations: Repeat-event intensity in custody does not estimate external geographic safety.
